heading: INT. HOLLOWAY FERTILITY CLINIC - CONSULT ROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. HOLLOWAY FERTILITY CLINIC - CONSULT ROOM - DAY
ON CAMERA: handheld, a crew of one.
A consult room, beige, a poster of a cross-section nobody asked for.
Dana, 30s, sits on the exam bench with a paper gown over her jeans, thumbs hovering over her phone.
Dr. Imran Haq, 50s, tablet in hand, takes the stool in front of her.
Dana, before we start, you're fine with the camera?
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: Wes thinks it's a bad idea. Wes thinks everything is a bad idea this month.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Understood. We can stop at any point.
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: Dana's phone buzzes.
We see the screen.
ON PHONE: where r u
ON PHONE: is it done yet
ON PHONE: call me
He's in the parking lot. He wouldn't come in.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Would you like to call him?
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: Put him on speaker. Maybe he'll listen to you.
units.name: DANA

units.text: She dials.
It rings twice.
Hey. Hey. Is the doctor there? Can he hear me?
units.name: WES

units.text: I can hear you, Wes. I'm going to share the results with Dana, and I'd like you to hear them too.
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: Fine. Just say it fast.
units.name: WES

units.text: The third cycle did not take. I'm sorry.
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: It's fine.
units.name: DANA

units.text: It's not fine, Dana.
units.name: WES

units.text: It's fine, Wes.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Dr. Haq glances at the camera, then away.
There is a fourth option. A different protocol. But you should know the odds are lower, and the cost is not small, and I would never push you either way.
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: You're not pushing.
units.name: DANA

units.text: You are pushing, though, kind of, I mean the whole place is a push.
units.name: WES

units.text: Wes, I'm going to hang up now.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Dana, take a moment.
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: I don't need a moment. I need him to stop talking.
units.name: DANA

units.text: I'm just saying we already spent
units.name: WES

units.text: I know what we spent.
units.name: DANA

units.text: She ends the call.
Silence.
The poster hums its bright pink hum.
Dana looks into the lens for the first time.
You can put that in the film.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Let's talk about the fourth option.
units.name: DR. HAQ

units.text: Okay.
units.name: DANA

units.text: Her phone buzzes once more.
She does not look.
A new message sits on the dark screen.
ON PHONE: sorry. im coming in
